correctness.rationale: Independently built the 12-vertex Cartesian rook graph, generated all 12 open neighborhoods and all 270 faces with face vector (12,66,120,60,12). Reconstructed 125 disjoint greedy matching pairs and topologically sorted all 792 oriented Hasse incidence arcs; critical cells exactly (1 vertex,1 edge,18 triangles). Evaluated signed integral Morse projection of each triangle to the unique critical edge: all eighteen attaching degrees zero. A CW model with 1 circle and 18 null 2-cell attachments has integral wedge S1 ∨ 18 S2 and pi1=Z. This is stronger than modulo-two Betti checks and a complete finite certificate.
